_comment: Mac launchd jobs retired for good (BRO-5085, plan BRO-4622). com.broadwayscore.checkout-sync reads this after every successful sync and, once an entry is RETIRE_GRACE_DAYS old, boots the job out and renames its ~/Library/LaunchAgents plist to <label>.plist.retired-<date>. Remove an entry (and restore the plist) to un-retire. Every entry must name its watchers: the pagers/health checks that watched the job, updated in the same change so retiring it does not page. Logic + rules: scripts/lib/mac-retired-reconciler.js.

entries.label: com.bwsc.opening-night-monitor
replacedBy: cloud Routine: Opening night live watch (Broadway)
cloud Routine: Opening night morning-after audit (Broadway)

watchers.note: Only runs inside the launcher itself, and already skips on the RETIRED: marker in data/opening-night-monitor/DISABLED (BRO-4638). After bootout the launcher never runs, so it cannot page.
